description: Toyota's read-only door to the Star Trek Bridge gateway (bridge.americansjewelry.com): sends one read-only request to any Bridge agent that offers a read-only operation (codex on agent_blocks by default), lists the Bridge's agents live, and reads back a task's status or result
notes: Normally no model runs here: Toyota's profile maps this name to receptionist_team/adapters/bridge_runner.BridgeDelegationRunner, which calls the gateway's client API (receptionist_team/bridge_client) directly. bridge_client/policy.py allows only inspect, explain and search_memory, checked against the Bridge's live GET /agents answer; implement, print, scan and workspace_write are never requested. See receptionist_team/bridge_client/README.md.
